question: In January 2022, which village became the first open-defecation free (ODF) Plus village of Mizoram?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Maubuang**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Maubuang** became the first **open-defecation free (ODF) Plus village of Mizoram** in **January 2022**.
 
• This achievement is part of the ongoing efforts under the **Swachh Bharat Mission** to improve sanitation and hygiene in rural areas.
 
• The ODF Plus status indicates that the village has sustained its ODF status and has implemented solid and liquid waste management systems.
 
• This milestone is a significant step towards improving public health and environmental sustainability in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM)** was launched on **2nd October 2014** by the Government of India, with the aim to **eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management**.
 
• Under SBM, villages across India are encouraged to achieve ODF status, which means no visible feces in the environment or village surroundings.
 
• The **ODF Plus** status is an advanced stage where villages not only maintain their ODF status but also implement effective waste management practices.
 
• Continued community participation and government support are crucial for sustaining the ODF Plus status and ensuring a clean and healthy environment.
